Terms & Conditions

These terms apply to your use of this website and to purchases of THIOTO closet air purifiers and filters. By using the site or placing an order you agree to them.

Product descriptions, images and specifications are provided in good faith and may be updated as the product improves. Prices and availability can change without notice.

THIOTO is a small air purifier for closets and similar enclosed spaces. It is not a medical device and does not replace ventilation, cleaning or medical advice.

Use the product as described in its instructions. Replace the filter when it needs it, and charge it only with a suitable Type-C supply.

Privacy Policy

We collect only what we need to take and deliver your order and to answer your questions: your name, contact details, delivery address and order details.

We use this information to process orders, arrange delivery and provide support. We do not sell your personal information.

Payments are handled by our payment provider. We do not store your card details.

To ask what we hold about you, or to have it corrected or deleted, contact us using the details on the Contact Us page.

Refunds

If your THIOTO arrives damaged or faulty, contact us with your order details and a photo, and we will repair, replace or refund it.

Filters and other consumables are best kept sealed until you need them, so we can take them back as new.

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method.

Shipping Policy

We ship THIOTO from India. Delivery times depend on your location and are shown when you order.

You will receive tracking details once your order has been dispatched.

If your parcel is delayed or arrives damaged, contact us and we will sort it out with the courier.

About Us

THIOTO is a closet air purifier: a small, quiet unit that hangs from a loop, draws air in through a removable front cap, passes it through a replaceable filter and sends it out through a rear top vent.

It is designed and made in small batches by the team behind THINK ROTOR, a precision products brand for engineering enthusiasts.

Contact Us

Questions about an order, the product or a replacement filter? We are happy to help.

Visit thinkrotor.com or message us on Instagram at @thioto_india.
